item.title: The next age of LLMs? Dev gets a small LLM running at 10 tokens a second locally on a $10 microcontroller

item.title: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
item.description: The appeal of free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels has always been the way they make it easier to (re)discover classic films and series. But Roku's latest experiment in the FAST space has less to do with traditionally produced entertainment and is entirely focused on giving viewers access to a constant source of AI-generated content.
